fields.label: Gateway Name
fields.description: Human-readable name for the merchant account, e.g. 'Yoco Neds'.

fields.label: Secret Key
fields.description: From Yoco dashboard → Developers → Online Payments. Used server-side to create checkouts.

fields.label: Public Key
fields.description: Publishable key (currently unused; reserved for future client-side flows).

fields.label: Webhook Signing Secret
fields.description: From Yoco dashboard → Webhooks. Used to verify webhook HMAC signatures. Without this, payment events are rejected with HTTP 400.

fields.label: Signup Fee (cents ZAR)
fields.description: Amount charged at doctor signup, in ZAR cents. e.g. 49900 = R499.00
